highYieldConceptSummaries.keyTakeaways: Cartesian product A x B contains all ordered pairs (a,b). A relation is any subset of A x B. A function is a special relation where each domain element has exactly one image.
Worst case complexity is measured in Big O. Binary search requires O(log n) time and sorted data. Bubble sort takes O(n^2) worst case.

items.name: Vector Triple Product
items.formula: a x (b x c) = (a . c)b - (a . b)c

recurringPastExamPatterns.patternDescription: அழகிடுதல் (வெண்பா யாப்பிலக்கணம்) மற்றும் அணி இலக்கணம் (உவமை, வேற்றுமை, தற்Structure) 5 மதிப்பெண் வினாக்களில் தொடர்ந்து கேட்கப்படுகிறது.
5-mark questions frequently feature Construction of Similar Triangles/Tangents, Solving System of Linear Equations in 3 Variables, and Proving Thales/Pythagoras Theorem.
SQL queries (JOIN, GROUP BY, HAVING) and Python CSV processing/Matplotlib visualization scripts appear consistently in Part-III and Part-IV.
